SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...What nonsense is that?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Don't you have other things to do? Do you really understand who you are?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You are about to pass exams! Do you even understand how important your summer time is?
[FI] I do. Indeed, I'm taking exams soon.
[FI] I've had an earful of how important this summer time is.
[FI] But you know... I can't just study all the time! What's really important is...
[FI] It's not that I take studies lightly. I do understand how important studying is.
[FI] But besides that, there are other more important things, right? Isn't that something you all always show me!
[FI] ...I just can't find a way to reply to this.
[FI] In that case, I'll be true to myself...
[FI] I've been laughed at by Kuroneko once before... But that's really all I have...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Those are two different matters!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] What?
[FI] It's natural to be worrying...
[FI] I've already taken the initiative. I've chose to listen to others talking about you, and chose to spoke to you.
[FI] It's already too late for me to stop!
[FI] Also, above all else...
[FI] Yes, because of that... right...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This is what I want to do.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-What nonsense is this? Are you going to let an emotional impulse ruin your whole life?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] As a test taker, you should be focusing on studying. That's how students are meant to be.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Unfortunately, rather than studying...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] It's true that I'm taking exams soon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Education is indeed important. I'll only bring trouble to my parents if I fail, and it will also destroy my dream of having a 'normal life'.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But above that, there's something much more important right in front of me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] How could I just abandon you when you're having problems?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I told you myself to leave me alone! And you plan to continue to do as you please?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I sure do! I'm not doing this just for you, but for me as well!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I decided to help you until I've accomplished my goal! And I also promised everyone that I would! Kirino, Saori... And above all, myself!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not going to give up in the middle of this.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Your goal? As if you'd have one!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, I do. I finally realized that I have a very important goal.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Why don't you tell me more about it then? What have you been going on about until now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, listen well. My goal is...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] To protect this world! This world with you in it! With Kirino and Saori by my side, I want to protect this world with you in it!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Stop messing around! To you, I am nothing...! Just a kouhai... A mere friend!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] This has nothing to do with being a kouhai, a friend, or a little sister! Stop sticking to those words!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What's important is what's inside! Words aren't enough, we need to go deeper! It's a matter of feelings!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I want to help you... Isn't that enough? Above everything else, I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I think that being by your side is more important!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I think it would be dangerous to leave you alone in your current state.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do consider the meaning of your words... You're no longer a kid.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do you still remember what you said before? I'm sure that thick head of yours contains no memory of it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] The words of someone like you won't be able to reach my soul!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Go home... And use that useless brain of yours to ponder on my words. If you manage to remember them, that is.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hold it! What exactly are you saying?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Have I said anything to hurt you!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You did in the past. On the way back from the game tournament. You clearly said 'I can't keep up with you".

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...'I can't keep up with you"'...? During the game tournament?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Ah.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-What's this carefree voice?! I...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You... were always concerned over that? That's why you've been avoiding me?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I-I wasn't... This is a good chance anyway, I just want to improve on interpersonal relationships.
[FI] Seeing as she was so troubled over something so stupid... I couldn't help but laugh.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Seriously... This is exactly why it's dangerous for you to be without me being around!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] W-What are you saying...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Couldn't you just ask me about it back then?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] To begin with, do you really not trust me enough to think I'd say those words with that meaning in mind?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Well, leaving that aside.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In reality, there are many things where I can't keep up with you. That's because I'm not an otaku. I can't draw manga too.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But that's just one facet of your hobbies. I never thought that I wouldn't be able to keep up with you on more important, basic aspects of yourself.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] So, do you understand now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Good grief...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Heh, it's laughable, isn't it? Everything happened because of my misunderstanding...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'm actually quite embarrassed...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] However...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Thanks to this, I got to understand and notice a lot of things... So this isn't actually a bad thing.
